items.line: **`find_author(author)`** takes the import dictionary and runs the three steps in order, name, `alternate_names`, then surname.
items.requirement: find_entity must attempt resolution in priority order: name with dates, alternate_names with dates, surname with dates

items.line: It owns the choice among candidates: a record with both years equal first, then the lowest key by numeric order.
items.requirement: When both birth_date and death_date are present, they disambiguate records, and an exact year match for both takes precedence

items.line: An import has no dates, and the same-named record has dates | The record is returned. Only the name is compared.
items.requirement: When either birth_date or death_date is absent, fall back to case-insensitive name matching alone, returning an existing record if one exists

items.line: **SC-001** (casing): Names that differ only in letter case resolve to the same record.
items.requirement: Matching must be case-insensitive; different casings of the same name resolve to the same record

items.line: **Given** authors `/authors/OL9A` "John Smith" and `/authors/OL3A` "Johnny Cash", **When** an import has name "John*", **Then** `/authors/OL3A` is returned.
items.requirement: Support wildcards in name patterns; "John*" returns first candidate by numeric key ordering; if none, a new candidate preserving the name including *

items.line: This needs both dates in the import, and both years must equal the record's.
items.requirement: A match via alternate_names requires both dates present in the input and exactly matching the candidate's values

items.line: **SC-003** (year gate): An alternate-name or surname match is never returned when either year differs, or either import date is missing.
items.requirement: A match via surname requires both dates present and exactly matching; surname path must not resolve if either date is missing or mismatched

items.line: **SC-005** (new author): An unmatched import keeps `name`, `birth_date`, and `death_date` unchanged, `*` included.
items.requirement: If no valid match, return a new author candidate dictionary preserving name, birth_date, death_date unchanged

items.line: **Date rules** stay with the existing `author_dates_match`, which compares years.
items.requirement: Year comparison for birth_date and death_date considers only the year component; any year difference invalidates a match

items.line: **`find_entity(author)`** delegates to `find_author`. It returns the existing record, or `None` when none matches.
items.requirement: find_author(author) accepts the import dictionary and returns a list of candidate records; find_entity delegates to find_author and returns an existing record or None

items.line: It returns whether `text` fully matches `pattern`, ignoring case, with `*` as any run of characters and `_` ignored.
items.requirement: Mock query behavior replicates production ILIKE semantics: case-insensitive full-string matching, * as multi-character wildcard, _ ignored
